critical_code_review_comments: VaultDocumentPicker in GrantClaims.jsx does NOT pass docKind — so every slot lists ALL vault docs regardless of required_label. Consider mapping required_label → doc_kind (e.g. 'GST Certificate'→'GST_Certificate') so Division sees only relevant docs. Non-blocking, but improves UX and enforces correctness (e.g. attaching a Bank_Account for a PAN slot is currently possible).

body_documents._can_read grants read access to any State body_code=='MPCA' with role in MPCA_READ_ROLES, but the header check uses caller_body=='MPCA' string literal. If BCCI hierarchy is introduced or MPCA code changes, this string breaks — extract to a constant / config lookup (bodies collection body_type=='State').

PATCH endpoint drops keys whose value is None via `if v is not None` — this means a client CANNOT clear a field (e.g. remove doc_no by sending null). Consider distinguishing 'unset' from 'null' via model_fields_set or a sentinel.
Soft-delete returns 200 with body {deleted:true, hard:false}; REST convention would be 204 No Content or 200 with the archived object. Minor.
BodyDocumentsVault.jsx handleDelete uses window.confirm — for consistency with rest of app (which uses shadcn AlertDialog elsewhere), replace with a themed confirm dialog. Non-blocking.

attachFromVault in GrantClaims should also update ai_verified / ai_confidence / ai_extracted or mark 'from_vault=true' so MPCA reviewer can distinguish a re-used vault doc from a fresh AI-verified upload.
